description: Helps you decide what to do next to move a deal. You give the deal name and stage, plus competitors, stakeholder positions and blockers. You get a deal health score, a strategy for the stage, next steps and risks to handle. Ask the user to confirm blocker status, economic buyer engagement, incumbent status and project status when those facts affect the score; typed facts take precedence over text. Read-only for business data. It needs no sign-in and stores no inputs or outputs. Hosted usage metadata is recorded. Missing required fields or invalid values return an error naming what to supply or correct. Use this instead of mutual_action_plan_generator when you need to diagnose deal health and choose the next move.

blocker_status.description: Ask whether any blocker is present. A confirmed typed fact overrides word reading. Format is text using one of the listed labels. For example, "none".

blockers.description: Known blockers or objections. Format is text. For example, "budget approval pending".

champion_status.description: Champion identification status. Format is text using one of the listed labels. For example, "no_champion".

close_date.description: Target close date. Format is text. For example, "2026-11-17".

competitors.description: Competitors in the deal and their position. Format is text. For example, "the current manual review process".

days_in_stage.description: Days the deal has been in current stage. Format is a JSON number. For example, 12.

deal_name.description: Deal/opportunity name. Format is text. For example, "annual renewal".

deal_stage.description: Current deal stage. Format is text using one of the listed labels. For example, "prospecting".

deal_value.description: Deal value in dollars. Format is a JSON number. For example, 12.

economic_buyer.description: Economic buyer name and engagement level. Format is text. For example, "finance director".

economic_buyer_engagement.description: Ask whether the budget holder actively participates in this decision. Overrides word reading. Format is text using one of the listed labels. For example, "engaged".

incumbent_status.description: Ask whether the buyer already uses a competing supplier. Overrides word reading. Format is text using one of the listed labels. For example, "present".

next_steps.description: Currently planned next steps. Format is text. For example, "schedule an exception review with the finance owner".

project_status.description: Ask whether the project is still active. A cancelled project is held, without a close plan. Format is text using one of the listed labels. For example, "active".

your_sector.description: Optional: your company's own industry (not your customers'). When given, it decides the sector notes; when left out, the tool reads it from your words and stays neutral if they are unclear. Format is text using one of the listed labels. For example, "logistics_tech".

your_solution.description: What you are selling. Format is text. For example, "invoice review service".

name: deal_strategy_coach
title: Deal Strategy Coach
